paper_metadata.title: Interaction between cognitive reserve and age moderates efect of lesion load on stroke outcome

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides clear inclusion/exclusion criteria and describes the recruitment process from a specific neurology department. While it acknowledges a potential selection bias toward less severe cases, the baseline characteristics are well-documented, and the use of a matched sample (n=104) effectively controls for sociodemographic imbalances.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The statistical approach is sophisticated, using interaction modeling to test the specific hypothesis. The authors report both linear and logistic regressions appropriately based on data distribution and provide clear visualizations of the interactions.

items.prompt: The selected statistical model is adequate for the design of the study.
